name_zh: 佩雷斯/以色列/诺贝尔/迪莫纳/奥斯陆/总统/核/新佩雷斯
description_zh: 夏蒙·佩雷斯 (1923-2016) 是以色列政治家，曾任总统。他领导以色列发展核计划（迪莫纳反应堆），推动奥斯陆和平进程，赢得诺贝尔和平奖，并提出新佩雷斯思想（以色列的创新与发展）。
description_en: Shimon Peres (1923-2016) was an Israeli politician who served as President. He led Israel's nuclear program (DIMONA reactor), promoted Oslo peace process, won the Nobel Peace Prize, and proposed New Peres Thought (Israel's innovation and development).
reason_zh: 核心思维：M537(诺贝尔/迪莫纳核/奥斯陆/总统/佩雷斯中心)、1(战略预判)、20(博弈论)、40(三衙分兵/军政分离)、67(战略敏捷)。佩雷斯体现了战略预判和博弈论精神，通过核计划实现战略威慑，通过奥斯陆协议实现和平进程，通过总统身份实现国家建设。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M537(Nobel/Dimona Nuclear/Oslo/President/Peres Center)、1(Strategic Foresight)、20(Game Theory)、40(Three-gate Separation/Military-Civilian Separation)、67(Strategic Agility)。Peres embodies strategic foresight and game theory spirit through nuclear program realizing strategic deterrence, Oslo Agreement realizing peace process, presidential identity realizing national construction.
steps_zh: 第1步：战略预判法——制定核计划大计：发展核计划和迪莫纳反应堆
第2步：博弈论法——核博弈：通过外交手段实现战略威慑
第3步：三衙分兵法——军政分离：通过总统身份实现国家建设
第4步：战略敏捷法——灵活外交：通过奥斯陆协议实现和平
steps_en: Step 1: Strategic Foresight - Formulate nuclear program plan: Develop nuclear program and DIMONA reactor
Step 2: Game Theory - Nuclear game: Achieve strategic deterrence through diplomatic means
Step 3: Three-gate Separation - Military-civilian separation: Realize national construction through presidential identity
Step 4: Strategic Agility - Flexible diplomacy: Achieve peace through Oslo Agreement
expected_zh: 发展核计划，实现战略威慑
促进以色列的和平与安全
expected_en: Develop nuclear program, realize strategic deterrence
case_zh: 1923 出生；2007-2014 任总统；2016 逝世；核计划/奥斯陆协议。诺贝尔/迪莫纳核/奥斯陆/总统/新佩雷斯范式永存。
case_en: 1923 birth; President 2007-2014; died 2016; nuclear program/Oslo Agreement. Nobel/Dimona Nuclear/Oslo/President/New Peres paradigm endures.
